control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity

facts.title: unplanned release of electrical energy at TX-8001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on TX-8001, G-8102 and G-8103 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. TX-8001 (station switchgear) is in service for station HV distribution. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 17 December 2016 a potential incident was recorded on TX-8001, G-8102 and G-8103 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during commissioning of replacement equipment; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
